purpose: Teach: 下っ/膨らま/別物/呼べる/挙動/利き/積もっ/引き込ま

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活、下っ端の頃、雑用ばかりだった。
lines.en: When I was new to the club, I just did whatever they told me to do.
lines.style: Dry, matter-of-fact drawl. Slight eye-roll in the voice—not bitter, just stating facts. Quick tempo. Lands hard on the complaint without dwelling.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お餅、レンジで膨らませると、面白いよな。
lines.en: Yeah. Mochi in the microwave—it puffs up all weird. Kind of hilarious.
lines.style: Light, conversational warmth. Genuine interest in the silly detail. A small laugh underneath the words. Leans in slightly, inviting her into the joke.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 同じテーマでも、レポート、別物に書けた。
lines.en: Even with the same topic, we'd write reports so differently.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slower pace. Recognizing something true without saying it outright. Soft tone—she's noticing a pattern about herself and Riku. Slight trailing-off, like she's still working through it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 親友、呼べる仲間、大事にしようぜ。
lines.en: People you can actually call—those friendships matter. We should hold onto them.
lines.style: Sudden sincerity, no affect. Direct eye contact in the voice. A beat of weight before speaking. Warm but unguarded—this is him being real, not performing cool.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昨日、変な挙動の子、廊下にいた。
lines.en: Yesterday I saw this kid in the hallway acting really strange.
lines.style: Curious, forward-leaning. Eyes-up like she's already picturing it. Light, observant tone—she's filing the detail away. Quick delivery, slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Casual question, but with an undertone of being up to something. Slight tilt in the voice—he's testing the waters. Soft enough not to be confrontational.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 雪、屋根に積もった、写真撮りたい。
lines.en: The snow built up on the roof. I really want to get a photo of it.
lines.style: Bright, immediate energy. Visual and present—she can see it. Quick breath between phrases. Genuine enthusiasm, not forced. Slight rise at the end like she's inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 最近の漫画、つい引き込まれちゃう。
lines.en: I've been getting totally hooked on manga lately.
lines.style: Admitted somewhat sheepishly, but with an undertone of genuine engagement. Warm, almost confessional tone. He's admitting to being drawn in—it costs him a little to say it.
